Kolonna Pradesiya Sabha
Declare as a Developed Area

AS per the powers vested to Pradeshiya Sabha by Sub Section (1) of section 134 to be read with Sub section (3) of Section 9 of Pradeshiya Sabha Act, No. 15 of 1987, It was decided under decision No. 31 dated 04/09/2024 consider the area described under the Schedule below as the developed area for the purpose of establishing assessment tax within the territorial area of Kolonna Pradeshiya Sabha and the general public are hereby informed that the Assistant Local Government Commissioner of Ratnapura District, given the approval for the above decision as per the powers vested by Sub section 134 (1) of the above Pradeshiya Sabha Act .
K.V. P. Irangani.Secretary and the Implementation Officer,
carrying out the functions, Kolonna Pradeshiya Sabha.
Kolonna Pradeshiya Sabha Office,05th September 2024.

Decision As per the powers vested to Pradeshiya Sabha by Sub section (1) of Section 134 to be read with Sub Section (3) of Section 9 of Pradeshiya Sabha Act, No. 15 of 1987 the Kolonna Pradeshiya Sabha decided to consider the area described under the Schedule below as the developed area for the purpose of impose and recover assessment tax and for that purpose I decided that the publish should be made after giving the approval of Assistant Local Government Commissioner of Ratnapura District, in accordance with the further provisions of Sub Section 134 (1) of Pradeshiya Sabha Act, No. 15 of 1987,
Situated within the territorial area of Kolonna Pradeshiya Sabha Ratnapura District, Sabaragamuwa Province
(1) The develop area from near Kolonna Nawanaliya bridge upto Maduwanwela 14th mile post Part 1-(Perimeter 4.228 km and area 0.250sq.k.m)
The develop area from near Kolonna Nawanaliya bridge upto Maduwanwela 14th mile post Part 11-(Perimeter 4.199 km and area 0.299sq.k.m)
(2) The develop area from Maduwanwela 14th mile post up to Ambagahayaya junction (Perimeter 4.549 km and area 0.395sq.k.m)
(3) The develop area from Ambagahayaya junction up to Jandura Kolonna Pradeshiya Sabha Boundary Part 1- (Perimeter 3.747 km and area 0.271sq.k.m)
The develop area from Ambagahayaya junction up to Jandura Kolonna Pradeshiya Sabha Boundary Part 11-(Perimeter 8.123 km and area 0.716sq.k.m)
(4) The develop area from Kella junction 100 meter finishing point of Kella Urubokka Road up to Walakada junction
Part 1- (Perimeter 4.055 km and area 0.162sq.k.m)
The develop area from Kella junction 100 meter finishing point of Kella Urubokka Road up to Walakada junction Part 11-(Perimeter 3.355 km and area 0.250sq.k.m)
